text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Neo Universe and the others
talking in the hallway.
However, the conversation was—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: W-What kind of language is that...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The language... "learned" recently...
Transcendence beyond the "stratosphere" of "deep consciousness"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "singularity" was... that day.
Neo Universe and the others... "observed"
an encounter with the "Unknown".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
How traditional――
A splendid――ryokan.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good choice, Universe!
Asking you to organize this day trip was definitely the right call!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is the "commander" of the trip.
Because it is a critical mission...
Executed the "optimal" path.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Category: 『Day Trip』.
Level: 『Best Plan』.
Wish to... "observe" everyone's 『delight』.

text_block_list.name: Ryokan Staff
text_block_list.text:
Then without further ado,
allow me to guide you to our prized room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~ Big expectations!
Let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What in the world is thissss!?!?

text_block_list.name: Bodysuit Staff
text_block_list.text:
This is our ryokan's pinnacle plan, the 『Subaru Chamber』,
exclusively available to guests residing in
the Pleiades star cluster.

text_block_list.name: Bodysuit Staff
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, having heard guests from this planet would accompany you,
we prepared an interstellar auto-translator compatible with all Solar languages.
Please feel free to use it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... when you asked for the best plan,
it turned out to be a plan for aliens!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? It actually translated something!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."EMGY". Neo Universe's request――
Appears to have been "CUTT"... to the ryokan crew.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, in other words... this plan
was outside of your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative... "Trajectory" alteration
to a plan "compatible" with the inhabitants of this planet...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Neo Universe wishes. For a 『Resolution』.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Same-day "trajectory" shift nears the "Roche limit"...
Upon "UNDY"... wish to entrust.
For everyone's "SISR".

text_block_list.name: Bodysuit Staff
text_block_list.text:
...My sincerest apologies for the grave misunderstanding.
I will guide you to a different room at once.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
............!
"Trajectory" correction to the Lagrange point: successful.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphaira... A "CMIN"... "SISR"... beyond
the "Menelaus Rille"... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What in the world is thissss!?!?

text_block_list.name: Octopus Alien Staff
text_block_list.text:
To think our guests hailed from the Andromeda Galactic Empire...
I terribly apologize. This room is styled in traditional Andromeda fashion.

text_block_list.name: Octopus Alien Staff
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, the Dzu-Izers is Fpu-Shifpufu,
Nuha-※▲×·Baa●ー＝◇◆■.
It is 3 Zems per use. Please feel free to enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Uncontrollable".
"Trajectory" correction... failed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――That was... the "DPSE"
encountered by Neo Universe and the others.
choice_data_list: Well, sounds like it was a good trip... in its own way?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We got to taste the sheer vastness of the universe!
I kind of want to build a huge castle somewhere on Mars now!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah. Truly――amazing.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If everyone "experienced"... "SISR"...
Then that is... Neo Universe's 『Joy』.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...In the next mission, wish to succeed
in "communication"... with the 『Unknown』.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Those words sound familiar.
Pretty sure back at that ryokan――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's the Cartwheel Galaxy accent, right?
The meaning was... let's see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...『I will stuff as many wet tissues
into your ears as physically possible』...
choice_data_list: Huh!? Th-That's not what I meant at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Casually attempting to imitate alien speech
earned an unexpectedly harsh scolding.
――Language is tricky.
